t: A low-cost RISC-V chip with Bluetooth LE 5.4 for small battery gadgets.
steps: Buy a WeAct CH592F core board. WeAct sells it on AliExpress, and some maker shops in India stock it.
Install VS Code and the PlatformIO extension. Add the community CH32V platform, which lists CH59x support.
Install the free wchisp tool for uploading programs over USB.
Open a blink example and build it.
Hold the BOOT button while you plug in the USB-C cable. The board enters its bootloader.
Upload the program with wchisp. Some users power-cycle the board right before each upload.
Try the Bluetooth beacon example from the WCH repo or the ch32fun toolkit next.
